patch_description:
No validator message was captured, so the failure must be inferred from the implementation. The original program uses a complex beam-search/SA pipeline with time-dependent early exits and several fallback plans. Those fallbacks can return arbitrary destination choices that are not consistent with the simulated state, making correctness depend on fragile recovery paths. It also risks timing out near the 2 second limit.

The fix replaces the fragile optimization pipeline with a direct deterministic simulation. For each required box in ascending order, it moves every box above it to a different currently shortest stack, then carries out the target box. Positions are updated after every move, so every emitted operation is legal. This always uses at most 400 operations for `n = 200`.
